enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Overwhelming Shockwave: This legendary weapon resonates with incredible power. On a Vorpal strike that is confirmed as a critical hit, it releases a Shockwave that does tremendous Sonic damage to all foes. Furthermore, the enemy that the shockwave is released on is Dazed from the force of the blast.
Reverberating 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 6d6 sonic damage on each hit.

Improved Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.
Fusible: Something about this item looks incomplete. Perhaps in the future it will be compatible with another item to create a brand-new fusion of the two.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
